name: atmega328p
comment: The ATmega328P: an 8-bit AVR with 32 KB of flash and 2 KB of RAM, the part on an Arduino UNO R3. The toolchain carries the startup and the linker script, so there is no vendor tree to fetch for it.

flash.comment: 32 KB of program memory, where the image is written

ram.comment: 2 KB of data memory, where the stack and the data live
